item.title: ‘Monsters, Inc. 3’ in the Works at Pixar; ‘Incredibles 3’ Set for 2028 Release
item.description: There are also new original films in development at the animation studio.

item.title: ‘It Ends With Us’ Author Colleen Hoover Says It’s Now “Easier to Separate” Blake Lively–Justin Baldoni Controversy From Film
item.description: "I think the actors, the director, everyone did such a good job making it," Hoover recently said.

item.title: Paramount Eyes Changes to Historic Studio Lot Following Warner Bros. Merger
item.description: The lot has hosted productions for films such as 'The Godfather,' 'Titanic' and the 'Mission: Impossible' franchise.

item.title: ‘One Battle After Another’ Takes Camera Operators Prize
item.description: 'The Studio' does the same on the television side.

item.title: Pete Docter Says Pixar Cut ‘Elio’ LGBTQ Themes Because “We’re Making a Movie, Not Hundreds of Millions of Dollars of Therapy”
item.description: The animation company's chief creative officer said they did not want their film to force parents to have conversations they weren't ready to discuss with their children.

item.title: Rosanna Arquette Says Quentin Tarantino Has Been Given “Hall Pass” to Use N-Word in Films: “It’s Not Art, It’s Just Racist and Creepy”
item.description: Arquette, who appeared in 'Pulp Fiction,' said the movie was "iconic" and "great," continuing to criticize the director's use of the word in his work.

item.title: Cinema Audio Society Awards: ‘F1,’ ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ and ‘Becoming Led Zeppelin’ Among Film Winners
item.description: The 61st annual commemoration of excellence in sound mixing was held Saturday night at the Beverly Hilton.
